context.args: Add removal-impact detection to WogiFlow's verification pipeline. When a type member, export, or union value is removed during a task, the wiring verifier should detect all consumers still referencing the removed item (including string literals, not just import names). This closes the gap where forward wiring checks exist (new file → is it imported?) but reverse checks don't (removed export → are all consumers updated?). This should be part of flow-wiring-verifier.js and run automatically for all WogiFlow users.
